title: Array Emptying
statement: An array of n values (n ≤ 2·10^5, a_i ≤ n) must be emptied in fewest operations: erase some x ≤ k or split x > k into two ceil(x/2), k rising by one each time. Each split costs two operations, so the answer is n+2S. Splits can all move first, so S is binary searched with a greedy check that the j-th smallest leaf is at most k+S+j.
